title: A regular ring is normal
statement: Let $R$ be a regular ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] (Noetherian, with every localization $R_{\mathfrak p}$ at a prime ideal a regular local ring). Then $R$ is a normal ring [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]: every $R_{\mathfrak p}$ is a normal domain.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 0567 (lemma-regular-normal, line 44046) and its proof: Serre's criterion Lemma Tag 031S (lemma-criterion-normal), a regular local ring is Cohen-Macaulay by Lemma Tag 00NQ (lemma-regular-ring-CM), giving (S_2); (R_1) is immediate
